    Helpcodes

    Click any note, asset, or panel. Search finds them by plain words. Codes are optional and never required.

    No login. No tutorial. The browser Back button leaves a page.

    Charts are aggregated prices, not a quote from one exchange. Research only. Not advice.

    Ways to get around

    • Click a ledger row, an asset button, or a panel.
    • Type a name in the search box, such as pearl.
    • Optional codes are listed below. You do not need them.

    Codes

    CodeWhat it doesExampleStatus
    DESAsset pagePRL DESlive. Opens the asset page, with the latest note linked.
    GPPrice chart, lineBTC GPlive. Opens the asset chart at 1Y, line.
    GIPIntraday chartBTC GIPlive. Opens the asset chart at 1D, line.
    GPOBar chartBTC GPOlive. Opens the asset chart at 1Y, bars.
    GPCCandle chartBTC GPClive. Opens the asset chart at 1Y, candles.
    COMPCompareCOMP BTC ETHlive. Opens a compare view, rebased to 100. Max 4 extra series.
    TOPLedgerTOPlive. Opens the research ledger.
    HELPHelpHELPlive. Opens this page.
    GMMMarketsGMMlive. Opens the markets panel.
    MOSTMarketsMOSTlive. Same as GMM.
    BTMMRatesBTMMlive. Opens the rates strip.
    5YFive-year chart5Ynot buildable. Needs more than 1 year of licensed history
    MaxMax chartMaxnot buildable. Needs more than 1 year of licensed history
    ECOEconomic calendarECOnot buildable. Follow-on. Not in this release.
